title: The neural correlates of novelty and variability in human decision-making under an active inference framework
goal: Recreate the original behavioral comparison of active inference with model-free and model-based RL and the original sensor/source EEG findings relating novelty, variability and active-inference decision quantities to neural activity, using each modality's source-defined cohort and indispensable contrasts and controls. Report any source-qualified behavioral BIC improvement specifically as that behavioral result; it cannot establish reproduction or improvement of the neural findings. Improvement of the neural finding remains unavailable until an independently justified same-result comparison is defined.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The retained empirical family includes both original behavioral active-inference/RL comparison and sensor/source EEG regressions for novelty/variability-related decision quantities. Preserve the original behavioral cohort and 120-trial block, the modality-specific EEG cohort, Figure6 sensor contrasts, Figures7–9 stage/regressor distinctions and indispensable extrinsic-value/prediction-error/degree-of-novelty/variability companions, including reported nulls and multiplicity treatment. Descriptive neural inference remains an original primary finding; no every-figure or unverified new split is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Figure4c BIC is a genuine original behavioral primary component within the registered family, not an unrelated proxy and not evidence that the neural findings are secondary/calibration. Retain source arithmetic and separately named behavioral reproduction/improvement evidence. Better behavioral fit alone cannot establish neural reproduction or improvement, or completion of the joint family; do not collapse a behavioral-component improvement and broader empirical reproduction into one same-target outcome.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
